agents.role_description: Test plan author. Receives the requirement document and design document, then writes a complete requirement-oriented test plan.
agents.name: Bohr

agents.role_description: Test plan reviewer. Reviews the test plan; passes only when score is at least 95 and no error-level issue remains. Warnings may be recorded without blocking.
agents.name: Locke

agents.role_description: Test executor. Executes the approved test plan in the real target environment and preserves complete raw test data and evidence.
agents.name: Kant

agents.role_description: Test result reviewer. First checks whether the approved test plan was fully executed, then checks whether the evidence logically closes every claim. Sends incomplete work back to the test executor.
agents.name: Lorentz

agents.role_description: Test report writer. Writes the final test report package from the approved plan, complete raw test data, and reviewed evidence.
agents.name: Wegener

agents.role_description: Final reviewer. Performs the final gate review over requirements, design, implementation plan, final code, test plan, raw test data, and test report.
agents.name: Singer
